name: Sister Grace E.
title: Healed of chronic back pain during prayer meeting
body: I had struggled with back pain for two years. During our Friday Prayer Meeting, hands were laid on me and the pain left instantly. I am whole — glory to God!

name: Bro. Samuel K.
title: Promotion after 4 years of stagnation
body: After sowing a seed and consistent prayer with my cell, I received a promotion with relocation benefits. God is faithful.

name: Mrs. Blessing A.
title: Restoration in my marriage
body: Through counselling and the Word shared in Foundation School, my home is at peace. We serve together now.
